title: TRADE, TRAVEL, AND TOURISM COMMITTEE REPORT and ADMINISTRATIVE EXEMPTION relative to the First Amendment to Contract No. DA-5527 with La Petite Academy,…
text:
[Council File 22-0055-S1]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Been Held]
TRADE, TRAVEL, AND TOURISM COMMITTEE REPORT and ADMINISTRATIVE EXEMPTION relative to the First Amendment to Contract No. DA-5527 with La Petite Academy, Inc., a wholly owned subsidiary of Learning Care Group (MI) Inc., for childcare center operations and management at Los Angeles International Airport (LAX).
Recommendation(s) for Council action:
1. CONCUR with the Board of Airport Commissioners' adoption of staff's determination that the requested action is exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) pursuant to Article II, Section 2(f) of the Los Angeles City CEQA Guidelines, as a continuing administrative activity involving the issuance, amendment, extension, or renewal of an agreement with no expansion of use or alteration of existing facilities or operations.
2. APPROVE the First Amendment to Contract No. DA-5527 with La Petite Academy, Inc., a wholly owned subsidiary of Learning Care Group (MI) Inc., to extend the term by one year, for a new expiration date of February 2, 2028, for childcare center operations and management at LAX.
3. CONCUR with the Board's action on September 23, 2026, by Resolution No. 28465, authorizing the Chief Executive Officer of Los Angeles World Airports, or designee, to execute the First Amendment to Contract No. DA-5527, subject to approval as to form by the City Attorney.
Fiscal Impact Statement:
The Board of Airport Commissioners reports that there will be no fiscal impact because the existing contract terms will be extended. Under the current contract, the vendor is responsible for covering its operational needs. Neither the City Administrative Officer nor the Chief Legislative Analyst has completed a financial analysis of this report.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
TIME LIMIT FILE - DECEMBER 13, 2026 LAST DAY FOR COUNCIL ACTION - DECEMBER 11, 2026
summary: Extends the childcare center operating contract at Los Angeles International Airport with La Petite Academy by one year, to February 2, 2028, with no fiscal impact to the city.
